answer: Prayers & Duties >> Salah (Prayer) Question ID: 69579 Country: India Title: Dua after Jumuah salah and sunnah Question: After Jumuah sunnah namaz can imam sahib make dua for all the musalli or we have to make dua separately. Answer ID: 69579 Posted on: Aug 30, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 926/933/B=12/1437) When the Imam supplicates after salam of Jumuah salah then he may supplicate for all the Muslims. It is not proved to make dua again collectively after offering sunnah. Yes, one may do dua after offering sunnah salah individually. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
